name: White Clarity
source:
White Clarity tells the story of Yuu, who resides in a mansion far from city lights. One day, Yuu discovers a young girl called Rino living in the basement of the mansion....

[Edited from [url=http://www.gwn.com/games/gameinfo.php/id/33410/platform/pc/title/White_Clarity.html]GWN[/url]]
translation:
《White Clarity》讲述了悠的故事。他住在远离城市灯火的宅邸中。一天，悠发现宅邸地下室里生活着一名叫莉乃的年幼少女……
